To find the official singer of the Mangueira samba school during the Carnival, I identified Mangueira as one of the traditional and well-supported samba schools in Rio de Janeiro that participates in the Carnival. The relevant information is found in the paragraph about Jamelão, who is noted as the official singer at Mangueira's carnival parades from 1949 to 2006. 

FINDING: Jamelão was the official singer of the Mangueira samba school during the Carnival.
